The shirt is plain, the background abstract, and the pose belongs to an ordinary conversational moment. Use gentle rose-violet concentric iris rings around clear dark pupils, with bright catchlights. A pale moon disc sits behind the portrait as a quiet background shape, suggesting Infinite Tsukuyomi without changing the expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
